positions.title: Principal Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Software consultant working to engage clients in new ways to leverage their healthcare data.

We were engaged with a nationally recognized pediatric acute care organization to create a custom innovative solution to visualize physiometric trend data.  Our small team completed all aspects of the system from initial formulation to successive refinement, release and support including several follow on engagements to expand on the success of the initial deployment.  My roles on the project included full stack software development, requirements gathering, business planning, user training and technical leadership.

projects.title: T3 Acute Care Visualization
projects.description:
The T3 Project focuses on capturing, storing and making understandable the troves of patient data generated in a modern ICU.  We developed a custom multi-tier webapplication to allow doctors and researchers access to their information.  The solution consists of a distributed multi-process Java backend with a custom HTML5/Javascript front-end which give clinicians unprecedented flexibility of display, from trends over weeks to the last few seconds of data with the drag of the mouse.

My roles on the project have spanned the gamut from gathering requirements to core development, user training, business planning, support and project management.
